6 of 8 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Internal Audit Plan for FY2008

The Internal Audit Plan for FY2008 was a review of the company's compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA). The committee reviewed the company's safety record and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To approve for implementation: RESOLVED, that the SEC Comment Letter Response Committee declares a quarterly dividend of $74 per share, payable on 2008-10-16 to shareholders of record as of 2008-12-28.

Moved: Cuong Prince  •  Seconded: Wafaa Anh
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review

The committee considered the Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review, a proposal to adopt a new policy on corporate political activity. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for corporate reputation: RESOLVED, that the SEC Comment Letter Response Committee approves the company's response to the shareholder proposal regarding Change-in-Control Severance Plan Review.

Moved: Carol Prince  •  Seconded: Fionnuala Samad
Vote: 4 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Retention Program — Key Employee Identification

The Retention Program — Key Employee Identification was a review of the company's performance against its ESG goals. Takeshi White reported that the company had met 74 of its 44 targets for the year. The committee discussed strategies for addressing the shortfalls.

Item 4
Director Independence Assessment

The committee discussed the Director Independence Assessment, a review of the company's compliance with trademark laws. The committee reviewed the company's brand portfolio and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To proceed: RESOLVED, that the SEC Comment Letter Response Committee approves the recommended approach to Director Independence Assessment as described in Exhibit D, subject to legal review to be completed within 15 days of this meeting.

Moved: Gulsen Mcfadden  •  Seconded: Wafaa Anh
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
